spendCap.covers: Paid gate spend only: Jev at its listed price and the reviewer at its API-equivalent cost, including the one reviewer check already run while planning (alreadySpentUsd). Agent time is outside the cap.
spendCap.rule: A running ledger adds the cost of every paid call to alreadySpentUsd. Before any paid call, if the ledger plus the largest single-call cost seen so far for that gate (for the reviewer, at least alreadySpentUsd) would exceed the cap, the run stops. A stopped run is published as partial, with the ledger. A partial run, whether stopped by this cap or by the reviewer hang-stop, gives no criterion a state and decides nothing about the claim; its counts so far are published as partial.

billing.basis: API-equivalent: the total_cost_usd that the Claude Code client reports for each run, at list price. Not an invoice; the runs may be billed differently.
